reviews.comment: Took her for a 6-week summer course and had a great experience! 1 exam every Friday + a cumulative final (6 total), lots of info packed into a week but you'll be fine if you stay on top of reviewing. Had multiple extra credit opportunities and easy assignments. She is super sweet and genuinely wants to see her students succeed! Take her if you can!
Not a good professor in any way.

Take her!! She is so caring and sweet, and does everything possible to make sure that we succeed. She holds review sessions before exams and stays up late to answer questions. She explains everything well and gives extra resources. She even embeds 4 extra questions into her exams as a cushion, so you can miss 4 and still get a 100. She's the best!!

Her lectures are packed with a lot of information but she does a great job explaining! I love that she had review sessions before exams, they were super helpful! Lots of cengage assignments but they are fairly easy. Study well before exams and attend the review sessions and you should be fine!

She is the BEST professor I have taken! She is absolutely amazing and truly wants every student to succeed! She offers SO much extra credit and lets you pick at the start of the semester if you want to come to class or not. I don't know why she isn't rated higher I can't recommend her enough! Go to her office hours she is there to help you!

I don't get why she isn't rated higher. She is so kind and wants to help her students succeed. The final is optional and replaces your lowest exam grade if you choose to take it. Study the slides and you will be okay. There's a participation activity every class but it really isn't bad. Labs are very easy and straightforward, I did have a great TA.

She gives ~20 points of extra credit and curves exams. I found her lectures to be easy to follow along with and her quizzes are usually more difficult than the exam content. There are 10 quizzes and the lowest 2 are dropped. The notes she posts are fill in the blank, so lecture attendance is important. I wish she taught more bio courses.

She's a great professor, but I admit that I wasn't able to pay attention a lot this semester (my fault) because of my other STEM courses and I did mediocre on the tests (all multiple choice) but still passed. She's an easy grader and curves the tests. The labs are not hard, simply common sense. Highly recommend.
banger of a professor
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Her lectures and study sessions really prepare you for exams. Multiple extra credit opportunities and hosts reviews before each exam. Exams can be a little conceptual and analytical but as long as you understand the topics and how they can be applied elsewhere you will be fine.

Go to all her office hours and scheduled appointments to get help if needed. She really wants her students to do well and is an amazing teacher. Her exams can be difficult but as long as you study you'll do well.

TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!! 4 tests (including the final), a problem set due each week, and MANY extra credit opportunities. Her test questions were pretty much copied and pasted from her lecture slides (very little analytical-type questions). The only downside is that you can only miss 3 or less lectures to receive full attendance points.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor!! She is active in Group Me, hosts her own study sessions on top of SI, and stays up late the night before exams. Exams have a built in 10 point curve and are easy if you study. Only complaint is that she takes a lot of time to answer question in class, which caused us to get slightly behind on material. I recommend her!

Dr Wright was an amazing professor who truly cared about her students. She offers many extra credit opportunities throughout the semester and a 4 question buffer on each test! Her lectures are very helpful in understanding the material. She is very accessible outside of class and held review sessions. Take Dr Wright!

She's honestly one of the best professors I've taken. Go to class because she does iClicker every day for attendance and attendance counts to the grade. do the assignments yourself to learn better. go to office hours. Whenever you're concerned. It's a little intimidating at first, but she's a very inviting and caring professor.

4 exams, 4 quizzes, and plenty of problem sets. She does offer extra credit which is nice, but i personally don't think she is very good at teaching. She definitely tries her best and offers a lot of review sessions and help. Go to lectures since she does attendance. Overall not horrible, but not great. If you can, take someone else! Lab is chill.

She is AMAZING and really cares about her students. Her class was really easy because she gave us so many resources and practice problems to succeed. She hosts reviews before each tests which really help understand the concepts that will be on the next exam. I could not recommend her enough. So much extra credit and help. I love her!!

She really shows that she wants all her students to succeed. She's very accessible outside of class and clearly puts in a lot of effort to make her class as understandable as possible. She encourages people to ask questions, which may slow down class a little, but I didn't have a real problem with it. Would absolutely recommend 😁

Professor Wright is a really good professor, you can really tell that she cares. The course is difficult but she tries her best to make sure her students understand. SI sessions most definitely help, and find study reviews.

Not sure why she has so many awful comments, BUT she is AMAZING. Exams are extremely easy and I study the night before or morning of & I'm def not an academic weapon😗 also she has review sessions before exams which are helpful! There are cengage assignments before every lecture which is okay I guess. Anyways take her class, you won't regret it!
Oh my gosh like my queen actually. She is such an angel. She is so understanding and makes the class very manageable. I had zero complaints with her. 100% would recommend!!

The easiest and nicest professor I have ever had. Lectures are guided, fill-in-the-blank, interactive slide shows. SO MUCH EXTRA CREDIT. Exams are extremely easy - towards the end of the semester, I stopped studying and am still getting 100's. Finishing the class with a 99. Dr. Wright is the most caring person I have ever met. Lab is easy and fun
very thoughtful, but can go on tangents but that never really set me back personally but others were bothered. If you have her I think you'll definitely pass

LOVE HER!! She's amazing just like a high school teacher! Highly highly recommend her. Way easier class then BIOL 111 and she gives so much extra iClicker credits. No final exam. Tests aren't to difficult and attendance isn't mandatory. She's amazing I don't know why her score is so low! Labs were not to bad and no lab exam!

Loved Dr. Wright! 5 tests and no final. ALOT of extra credit so go to class. She is so caring and you can make a personal relationship with her! She's the sweetest! She also does an exam review the Sunday before the test, which helps a lot so I recommend going to those.

BIO 111 is a very amazing class to take with her all classes are attendance mandatory and every class consist of purely just notes so it's very important to show up to class. Outside of class there's very few assignments such as problem sets, lecture quizzes ONLY before the exam, and extra credit assignments which I strongly advise be done.

Dr. Wright is one of the best profs at A&M! Her lectures are very detailed and exams are pretty easy as long as you study. She really took the time to answer questions and even respond to feedback on how to improve the class. She has a bright personality which made lecture much more enjoyable and clearly is passionate about the course.

Wright is very committed to the content and students. Has a GroupMe where she sometimes stays up until midnight to answer questions. Lots of extra credit. Tests are light with 4 "bonus questions". If anyone failed, its on them not on Wright. Study and you'll be fine no doubt.

Honestly cannot recommend enough. So many extra credit opportunities AND she makes specific reviews and guidelines for all exams. Easy to get a good grade in this class and lab assignments are also not time consuming compared to other science courses.

Dr. Wright has by far been my favorite professor so far. She is caring, engaging, and up to help out with anything you need. Her class is not easy, but she does everything in her power to help you succeed. Do the extra credit and go to exam reviews they help lots. Also, SI sessions are a must! I am not kidding y'all trust me! Take her!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: she knew she was a little lost i think so she made up for it with extra credit
she is honestly a pretty good professor she does get lost talking about one thing for all class but i think she knows it and makes the exams easier for it and gives extra credit

I enjoyed Dr. Wright's class: she was very helpful throughout the semester. She provided detailed explanations if you had any questions from previous assignments or exams. You can tell she is very passionate about what she teaches and provides extra credit throughout the course. If you can, please take her!

Dr. Wright is a great professor and so down to Earth! She puts so much effort into every single one of her lectures (extra credit too) and does a great job at highlighting what she will ask on each test so LISTEN during lectures. You can miss 4 questions on each test (including the final) and still get a 100. Basically +10 points no matter what.

PLEASE TAKE HER. At first, I was scared of taking this class because her rating was not as good as had hoped. However, in her class, Dr. Wright takes the time to explain concepts from scratch although explained previously. MOST IMPORTANTLY, go to her review sessions, she reviews the not only the main ideas but also what is most likely on the exams.

TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!! I cannot recommend her enough idk who is not rating her good bc Biology can be difficult but if you do an ounce of studying outside class you'll be fine, her quizzes before the exam are her past year exams which are super helpful for exams, she also lets you take your exams home after you're done so you can study them, LOVE HER
Dr wright is amazing and always available for questions. She puts in so much work for her students and does her most to help in anyway she can.
SUPER easy exams
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr.Wright is AMAZING!!! She is easily accessible outside of class and her weekly review sessions are very helpful. She is very caring about her students. She breaks everything down super well and makes it easy to understand. Lots of iClickers in class for extra credit. Best prof I have had so far!

She is very sweet and cares a lot about her students. There is a lot of extra credit and if you put in the work, it is very easy to get an A. She lectures kind of slow and I found it difficult to pay attention sometimes, but I would highly recommend her.

Very sweet and understanding. She gives great lectures that are entertaining. She is active in office hours, SI sessions, and GroupMes to provide extra instruction. Her assignments were great preparation for exams, and were mostly open note. I don't know why she doesn't have a higher rating. Would most definitely take her again.

She is amazing!! I cannot recommend her enough. She is extremely helpful and her lectures are very entertaining and engaging! Before every exam, she hosts multiple review sessions and is very willing to help out her students. One of the best profs at tamu for sure!!

Wright is so sweet! She reminds of a high school teacher who genuinely enjoys her job and cares about your success. Accessible outside of class. Go to office hours! I got a B because I am not the best at biology, but I know many people who did AMAZING in here. Labs suck and TAs grade hard. Overall, would take her again!

Dr. Wright's class was really easy for me, though biology comes naturally for me! She had easy to understand PowerPoint slides and demos. Quite the bubbly personality! My only complaint was that sometimes, she focused on iClickers a bit too much and we didn't cover all the materials before exams.

Rachel Wright is amazing. She is a great teacher and has so many office hours and extra help for her students. Her tests are easy and basic, as long as you put time and effort into studying. Go to class for the iClickers. She responds to emails quickly and is very sweet.

Dr. Wright cares a lot about her students but I honestly didn't find her lectures the most helpful. Go to class for iClicker extra credit! I also heard that SI/office hours are really helpful. Overall the class is not bad and Dr. Wright is a pretty good prof.

I honestly loved Dr. Wright. She made her lectures very easy to understand and was very interactive in class and easy to reach outside of it. She offered lots of extra credit and review sessions for exams to make sure you understand the material. The tests are very straightforward and if you stayed on top of your work it does reflect well.

Dr. Wright is a kind and caring professor. She is always eager to help her students and get to know them. In class, she gives out a lot of extra credit. The SI sessions were very helpful, and Dr. Wright provided us with reviews and practice tests before the exams. I would definitely recommend taking this class.

Dr. Wright is a queen, she is genuinely one of my favorite professors. I thought biology would be super hard, but her weekly reviews make it so much easier. If you want extra credit, show up because she does iClickers. Tests aren't that bad, obviously study, especially for exam 3. If you're taking bio 111, do it with Rachel. She's my fav.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved Dr Wright!She cared a lot and genuinely wanted her students to succeed. She offered a lot of extra credit and ways to teach us how to study which was helpful for the ones taking the class as a first sem freshman.She gave us the tests from last year to study and they helped a lot!Just read over the slides a lot to study. I def recommend her!

Dr. Wright is a good professor but she grades very very hard and it is not worth taking her class because it will be hard to get a good grade. The labs are pretty easy but the lab reports are somewhat difficult and can take a while. She doesnt give any grace when it comes to asking for some help with your grade but she provides many study sessions.

I absolutely love Dr. Wright!! She is a great teacher & wants students to succeed (but lectures can be boring at times). I recommend going to SI sessions and Dr. Wright's weekly reviews, that's really the only reason I did well in the class. I couldn't recommend her more and you should do well in the class if you utilize the resources she provides!

Dr. Wright is an amazing teacher. The class itself is hard but if you go to office hours, take lecture notes, and study you will do well. She also gives a ton of extra credit opportunities which really helped me in the long run. She wants you to do well and going to office hours is really what got me through!
The class is hard but if you go to her office hours and study for the exams you will do well. She is such a kind person and gives tons of extra credit opportunities for just going to class!

She genuinely cares about her students and their success. Even offering bonus points during her lectures for those who show up. Make sure to pay attention to her lecture slides as that is where you will find more information for the exams. She does tend to rush at the end of the semester, but you can always ask her to slow down and explain.
Dr. Wright is an amazing and caring professor. She offers test review sessions and always answers questions. Her tests are not very difficult and the labs are easy. I can't recommend her enough.

Dr. Wright is truly amazing! I recommend sitting close to the front, if you can. I don't understand why people gave her harsh ratings on here. She is super sweet, light-hearted, and fun to talk to! She tends to go fast, but she is more happy to go back if need be. Labs are not hard at all and the SI Sessions were very helpful!

Although her classes are very hard, Dr. Wright is a very good professor. She made sure everyone understood the material and had 2 office hours a week and we had a wonderful SI leader who helped a lot. I highly suggest Dr. Wright. We had 4 tests total she always added in extra/buffer questions. She wants to help you succeed.

She is genuinely so sweet and the class is so easy! If you bare minimum study, you're guaranteed to get an A. If you can, take this course versus BIOL111 because she has more control over extra-credit, grading criteria, etc. Her exams weren't at all hard and they tend to have an extra few questions inbedded in as a "curve". LABS WERE EXTREMELY EASY

Prof wright was honestly so good! She held reviews outside of class before every test and made sure we understood it. If you put effort into learning her material you would be fine. It's very lecture heavy, and you just have to actually apply the information. You get around 10-20 points of extra credit for attendance, then another 10 later

Dr. Wright is the best biology professor. She is very nice and will help you if you need it. The class material is difficult and requires studying, but Dr. Wright will help you and get you the help you need. Her office hours and weekly reviews are really helpful in reviewing topics and preparing for exams.

I could take Dr. Wright for the rest of my biology courses. She is an awesome professor and makes complex biological concepts so easy to comprehend. You need to put in effort to fail this class. If you found this class overly difficult, you did not take advantage of the resources available to you. If you want to actually learn, take her!!

She's an absolutely great prof! I agree that she tends to move a little fast, but if you attend her office hours, she'll come up with 10 examples to make sure you get it! She makes reaching her outside of lectures super easy. Her exams are easier than the other profs'. Overall, love her, don't get the hate, and would 100% take her again.
I have a bad grade due to lack of studying, however she is brilliant and extremely helpful. One on the sweetest ladies ever! I would take her class again.

Literally I don't know why other people are saying she's hard, she gives so many ways to study like it's almost impossible to fail unless you are really trying to. She gives us last years test and you can study from that for the tests. The tests are very straight forward, so you just have to know the material and you will be fine.
Everything that comes up on exams is taught in lecture. Attendance not mandatory but helpful to get bonus points from iClicker quizzes and polls. Very sweet and approachable.

I took this class over the summer and it was my favorite class I have taken so far. The class is exam heavy but with all the extra credit it is easy to get an A. Dr. Wright always made extra time to help us study before exams, with review sections after lab/lecture, and always responded to our emails/questions, even during our late night studying.

I took her as a freshman, (I am a senior now) and she was by far the hardest professor I have ever had. She tries to trick you a lot on her exams. The only reason I made an A is because of all the extra credit she offered during class. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!

The start of every new unit she started off strong but as the unit progressed her lectures felt more rushed. Her homework was pretty easy and sometimes would relate to the exams but also sometimes wouldn't. Overall she was a very nice professor and I would take her again just wished my TA for the class did a better job at explaining lab.

Professor Wright is amazing! If you study then you will do just fine. There is a textbook but everything on the exam is completely covered in lecture. Attendance is not mandatory, but I highly recommend going. There are extra credit iclicker questions spontaneously in class and the notes are fill in the blank.

Dr. Wright is one of the sweetest professors on this campus. She tends to go slow in lecture - but will adjust test content or post completed notes if she gets behind. She is very accessible outside of class with her exam review sessions, office hours, and before/after class. Going to lecture is a must to understand exam material.

She's nice but spent too much time on the intro chapters. She sped through the remaining material which made it difficult to study. Not a hard class but you'll have to teach yourself most of the material. If you take her you'll probably get an A, but be ready to supplement with other resources. I would recommend Bozeman Science on YouTube.

Dr. Wright is honestly a really sweet professor!! You absolutely have to attend lectures to take notes, or you WILL fail your exams. She tends to get behind, but she'll post the full notes if that happens. She also held a review for the final exam!
Took her class because she had good reviews, she goes really fast, and rushes thru the material for the exams. labs are easy and gives extra points, but overall wouldnt recommend.

Dr. Wright is an amazing professor! Biology is just a hard class in general, but she is so caring and wants all of her students to do well. She gives out so much extra credit that it bumps your grade up multiple points. Her tests are difficult and require you to study, but it is doable. She is an awesome professor who I highly recommend.

this professor has given me a very hard time for this class, she rushed through things and expects us to know everything already.she does not really teach, she just reads off the slides.i felt excluded compared to other students. she had a passive aggressive attitude towards some people. she makes everything more confusing DONT TAKE HER CLASS!!

Dr Wright does an amazing job teaching Zoo-ology. she's very caring and obviously cares about her students, she gave our class numerous extra credit opportunities through Iclicker-class participation, and by letting us do a makeup exam. Def a class you'll have to study for but not too difficult.

i signed up for her class because she had good reviews, wouldn't recommend it. she takes a LONG time on the first chapters and then rushes through the rest of the chapters just do fit them into the test. she is kinda rude, and isnt really helpful to understand the topics. the only good thing is the extra credit. the labs are pretty easy tho.
Tough exams, and labs where quite easy, and bumped up my grade a lot, but overall a tough class. She went way too fast during lectures and didn't give a lot of time to write things down.

Dr. Wright is an amazing professor! HOWEVER! do not take biol 107 if looking for an easy life and physical sciences. This class definitely took the most amount of my time studying and tests were challenging. Nothing but amazing things to say about Dr.Wright as long as you have to take biol 107. IF NOT DONT TAKE IT & make my mistake.

As a Freshman on the pre-med track, I was told to take this course even though I had credit from a 4 on the AP exam. It dove much deeper into the concepts than my AP class did, but the questions on the exams involved less problem-solving and more memorization. Her office hours single-handedly got me an A. She explained things much better there.

She got confused with herself often but she tried her BEST to help us understand. Lots of info to remember but I liked it. 3 exams + 1 final cumulative. Most grades from lab quizzes and assignments which were fairly easy. If you study well and take thorough notes you will be fine. I got a 98 total and aced the final. But I also love science.

Professor Wright is a great professor. Her tests are not too complicated and is very similar to what I learned in AP biology. She doesn't puts things she didn't go over in class on the test. She does iclicker questions in class and they count towards extra credit.

She is really sweet and ready to help. The class wasn't bad, but her lectures were hard to follow. She would confuse herself multiple times. She would spend too much time on one chapter at the beginning of the unit and rush through the rest of the material right before the test. My advice: look for other professors

Dr. Wright is an amazing professor who truly cares about her students, she shows compassion and is always available to help out. Her lectures are captivating (but I am a nerd). She gives lots of reviews and extra credit opportunities. Take her!

Dr. Wright is an amazing professor and I would recommend her to anyone taking Biology 111. I do have background knowledge of biology which helped contribute to my grade, but she offers review sessions, office hours, and SI sessions so take advantage of that if you are struggling! Also lots of extra credit but you have to be in class.

Attendance not necessary, but extra credit offered in class majorly boosts your grade. If you understand everything on the reviews, you should be fine getting an A on the exams. Lecture notes only matter if she highlighted a exam question tbh.

Great professor! She really cares for what she teaches and it shows. Her course has a textbook, but the lectures cover everything on her exams. He also offers several opportunities for extra credit through attending class. Overall, a great and caring professor.

Professor Wright is a very nice person and gives up to 30 extra iclicker points. However, I personally had a hard time learning from her lectures and mostly self studied. She does hold exam reviews and posts practice exams which are very helpful. Overall, she was a pretty good professor!

The material's difficulty matches the difficulty of her tests. If you can answer the learning objectives she provides which line up with her lectures, you'll be fine. She explains concepts thoroughly and will take the time to answer questions. So, attend class for the sake of understanding and extra credit (iclicker) which she only gives in class.

After the first exam, I learned that making flashcards on most of the details on her slides was the key to getting good scores on her exams. While she does get caught up with drawing structures and loses track of time, she gives away bonus points like candy (for me and extra 8 percentage points!). I went from a D to a B after studying correctly.

The slideshows sucked and I taught myself most of the material. She will put questions from the practice tests on the exam and questions from past exams on the final. Attendance is not mandatory but go to class for extra credit and the slides are left partially blank, so you have to go to class to get the information.

Dr. Wright is so caring and the class is manageable as the year goes on. She does reviews, loves meeting us, and gives you the experience you make of it. If you go to class you can get up to 30 bonus points, and her assignments are super easy once a week. Spend time prepping for exams and you'll make a high grade. I wish I could take her for 112!!!

She cares abt her students. At the beginning of the semester, it is a little bit overwhelming, but as it progresses, it gets easier. The exams are difficult, but if you study, youll be fine. Lots of iclicker points, always has office hours and will reteach anything. She holds reviews before each exam. Overall, great prof and would take again.

If you took AP bio, this class will be a breeze. Rachel lowkey shat. She goes a little way too fast during lectures. She usually only reads the slides. Sometimes she will go off topic on the most random, most useless shat. Overall, I like. She nice! Grade EZ if study. If nawt, good luck!1!1!!

Rachel Wright is a great professor that cares a lot about her students. She does the most to make sure we have needed material for exams, she gives out reviews with full practice tests, and holds review sessions for every exam. Bio is not an easy subject so be ready to put in the work, but A LOT of extra credit is given. I would recommend her!

Rachel Wright is so great. Her tests are difficult, but they are not meant to trick you. She gives TONS of extra credit just for going to class. She also responds to emails really quick and loves to meet with students one on one. She is super nice and approachable. I ended up with a 104 in the class. LOVE HER.

This class is very lecture heavy, but as long as you understand the material, you should be perfectly fine. Her lectures are not necessarily interesting, and she reads off her lecture slides. Wright is extremely generous with bonus points and they are guaranteed as long as you attend class and get iClicker questions right.

While Dr. Wright is an AMAZING person, she is not a good professor. Only reason I did well in this class was because I had prior knowledge of biology and attended class. Lots of extra credit, but it is unbearable to sit through her lectures. It's almost as if she's TOO smart and does not know how to teach others what she knows.

Dr.Wright seems awesome as a person, but I wouldn't take her as a professor. Her lectures frankly don't make sense. If you don't already know all of the material that this class covers, you will probably find yourself looking up YouTube videos on every unit.

I feel cheated by this class. I took Zoology because of an interest in animals and classification. However, I would describe this class as intro to biology. We were so far behind the intended chapters the entire semester that we didn't get to any zoology material until the last 2 weeks of class. Additionally, she makes simple  things seem hard.

Dr. Wright is an amazing professor but BIOL111 is a very difficult class. If you're good at science I would highly recommend her. She's very good at explaining things and answering questions and is accessible outside of class. She has SI sessions outside of class and I would highly recommend going to those whether you're struggling or not.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her lectures were not super engaging and by the end I just went for any bonus points I could get from iClicker questions. The labs were interesting, but lab exams were a little tough. The exams weren't too bad.

Her slides were very confusing, unorganized, and had lots of spelling mistakes. She is a great person but she likes to ramble and will go through things very quickly so it is hard to keep up. However, if you ask a question she will do her best to explain it in multiple different ways until most of the class understands.
Know how to study and you'll do well!
textbook is online, grades are normal, tests are very difficult.

She is a very sweet and wants students to succeed, however, her exams are horrible and are extremely tough. Everything from the exam comes from the problem sets and lecture slides, so no textbook is really needed. Her class is extremely lecture heavy. Her teaching style is not the best, so be ready to learn everything by yourself.

Took it as a 5 week summer course with exams and problem sets every week. Approachable, organized, and caring professor who is willing to help any of her students. Pay attention, study the powerpoints, and ask for help and you will be successful in her class.

I took this class as a 5 week summer course. At first, it was overwhelming to know we would have an exam each week, but Dr. Wright did everything she could to help us be prepared by offering review sessions and 2 questions extra credit on each exam. Dr. Wright really cares about her students, and by putting in the work, a good grade is possible!

Dr. Wright is an excellent professor and gives her students every bit of information they need in lecture to be very successful in the course. She is very approachable and clearly cares tremendously about her students' success, and has clearly done a great job of adapting her course over the years in response to feedback.

I took this as a 5-week course so we had an exam every week. It is a difficult class but Dr. Wright makes it easier. She gives 30 extra credit points, 2 bonus questions on each exam and a review with her before each exam. You have to study and exams arent easy but if you go to every lecture and study a little everyday you can do really well.

Many of these reviews are outdated because Professor Wright clearly took the feedback and made things easier for her students. Lots of extra credit. Tests are fairly hard but you will at least get a B on them if you read all of the power points noting important concepts the night before. Very sweet and really wants students to succeed.

Very sweet lady. Tests are not difficult if you study. She offers a ton of extra credit on them. She really wants her students to succeed and tries her best to make sure everyone understands. With that being said ask questions and go to office hours if you don't understand. She is very helpful!
Attendance is not required, but a lot of extra credit was given just for showing up. If you pay attention and take notes exams are not hard. The lab was easy and not graded hard at all.

The class is easy. If you go to office hours Dr. Wright will help you get 100% on homeworks. She offers extra credit but you have to be in class. Tests aren't bad if you show up to class and understand labs. Doing labs and understanding them is best way to learn content tbh.

Dr. Wright comes from more complex courses, so she is used to harder material and more experience bio students. That said, she has adjusted the course to be easier to grasp for new bio students as the semester has gone on. I studied the night before most exams and averaged a B overall, but generally, if you put in the work, you can easily make it.

Her tests and lectures are not easy, but the class is 100% manageable if you study.  The first few exams were rough, but she offered extra credit for exam revisions.  This is in addition to 30 extra points for participation.  Those who complain aren't doing enough on their end because if you put in the work, you will do just fine in this class.

She's better for students who already know what they are doing. If you know nothing about biology pick a different professor. The way she explains things can be difficult to understand and she often contradicts herself and often students will correct her. I think dumbing it down confuses her but just go to test reviews.

Dr. Wright taught this course for the first time this year, and she did a decent job with it. You have to dedicate time to learning the information and attend lectures. She is very helpful and seems to do her best to help everyone do well in her course.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
She got better after the first two tests but it was already too late and now I'm worried about passing this class. 
pick a different professor.
She lectures very fast and it is hard to keep up most times, also she gave extra credit on the first two exams but not the third because so many people in the class failed the first two times.

Dr. Wright gets hate for difficult material, but she really was understanding and flexible. This was her first time teaching 107, and she said she'd make some improvements for next semester. There aren't many grades, just exams and lab, so take advantage of exam review material and extra credit. She mostly reads off slides, but answers questions.

Dr. Wright is very kind but her class is impossible. There's no way to pass unless you pay $50 to access the extra credit. Her tests make no sense and every time they have a failing average. Skip her for a better prof.

The issue with this prof is her exams are much harder than any other profs and she's not very good at lecturing. I studied really hard for this class last semester yet did very poorly in her class. I ended up Q Dropping and took Fletcher and have a 96 so far in the class and feel like I truly understand everything she lectures about in class.

Dr. Wright was an AMAZING professor. Her powerpoint were organized her lectures were easy to follow. Many people complain they were overwhelmed with information during lecture but this is meant to be a difficult class. She gives you the knowledge needed and you should self-study to have fully understand(theres only so much you can learn in 75min).
Avoid this prof. Do not tank your gpa or make your semester more challenging with her.

Wright was a microbio prof before she started bio 111, making it hard for her to dumb things down. Though she's nice, her slides were very overwhelming, leaving us to learn it all ourselves. Her class was hard but it could have been avoided if she made things clearer in class. Exams are a pain, you have to read between the lines to get what's asked
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Here's everything you need to know: 4 hard tests and a final. Weekly homework was ez, answers are on quizlet. You want extra credit? then you have to pay like 45 bucks for it. She made the class unreasonably hard and her tests were nothing like the reviews. Every test had a failing average with no curve. Lab portion was easy. Please dont take her.

Dr. Wright is a nice person, but she makes this class almost impossible. Lectures are very long and include tons of information but she literally just reads directly off the slides so you end up having to teach yourself everything. Lots of extra credit is offered though so go to class. Tests are worded very confusingly and she doesn't curve at all.

This is an introductory class and unfortunately Dr. Wright made it more difficult than it should be. Her lectures were very long and and contained a lot of information. Practice tests were easy but exams in class were tough.  Extra credit was helpful towards grade but must attend class to receive. Very nice lady but hard professor.

She was a good professor. She was EXTREMELY helpful in office hours and would learn your name. She truly wanted us to succeed. Do you have to work for your grade? Yes, but that comes with every prof.She is super sweet and by the end of the semester was really good at lecturing. Many reviews were written early on but she definitely improved greatly.

Dr. Wright is really nice, but her class is not easy! I can not stress enough how useful office hours are, so if you're confused and lost ATTEND or EMAIL! Put the work in, and you will do good. People who are complaining did not put the work in. You will need to study. No curves and extra credit! Best of luck she is great.

Dr. Wright spent all of her lectures reading directly off of the slides. Whenever a question was asked she could not explain the answer without contradicting herself. Although not curving tests is a BIOL 111 department policy, Dr. Wright's tests were harder than other professors'. Okay class but Dr. Wright made it unnecessarily challenging.

if you put in the work and go to class, you can get an A in this class. the professor is super nice, but can sometimes be confusing. she loves to give extra credit, so if you are worried about an exam grade it probably won't be an issue down the line. she doesn't curve!!!

Lectures were not very interesting and difficult to sit through. Very little hw, but exams are very difficult in comparison. Exams were also considerably more difficult than other 111 bio profs. Practice exams were not written by her so they did not really help. But, she did give alot of extra credit and was reachable but email/ office hours.

Professor is honestly the worst teacher you can ever have freshman year of college. Don't go to her class because she literally reads off her slides just go for participation points that's usually before the class before an exam and one after. The test are hard and you likely going fail even if you studied honestly good luck.

Dr. Wright is a very nice person, but her lectures are really just her reading off of the slides the whole time. I feel as if she makes the concepts much more complicated than they need to be based on her background. I would recommend going with a different professor for sure.

She's a nice person, but her class is really difficult. Her exams are written in a way that is really confusing and very specific. It makes preparing for them very difficult. The extra credit was the only thing that saved my grade.

She goes through the lectures WAY too fats and doesnt really explain anything that is going on. The only module she spent time on was the genetics module because she actually cares about it. Her tests are extremely hard and confusing, youll sit there questioning what its even asking. Her practice exams and chpt outlines dont help.

She covers material in class but the material does not prepare you for the exams. She has slides but even information in the study guides and on the exam is not covered in the slides. I would not recommend her at all. Averages on exams are literally failing (65-55) but she does not curve.

This class is the most difficult class I've ever taken. There hasn't been a passing average on any of the tests, but Wright refuses to curve it. I gave the class a 2/5 solely because the prof is really nice, but that's it. Nothing she says sticks and I dread going to class. It's not mandatory but there's 30 extra credit throughout the semester.

For someone that has their doctorate in genetics/ taught microbio, Dr. Wright does not seem to have a grip on gen Bio. I have friends in Organic chem and bio 111 right now and their grade in ochem is higher. She will be reviewing inclass and say that she is "confusing herself". Averages are 65 and below every test, but she has never curved.

Yall do not take this class unless you want to be crying in a study room at night with the rest of your bio classmates who know just as much as you (nothing). I am telling yall it was just awful. I did not learn anything, half the stuff I do know is because I taught myself. She has office hours, but they aren't that helpful. Good luck!
She is really nice and puts in a lot of effort into her class. But the tests are really hard, so you are going to have to study a lot.

There are 50+ slides per lecture and she skims over important topics while focusing on useless hard topics that when questioned about says "you don't need to worry about this for my course". Genuinely a really really bad lecturer and a worse test maker.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The worst professor Ive had this semester. She goes through so much material so fast in one hour and her outlines and practice exams help in no way for her actual exam. She tries to trick students with her questions which leaves you wondering if there was anyway that you could have even studied for the exam. Just awful.

Dr. Wright is the worst professor I have ever had. She puts too much content in her slides and goes over at least 60 per class. Test questions are extremely confusing and uses them to trick us. Graded my exam with her after class, got a 72, but on canvas she gave me a 60. When I emailed her about it, she was no help. Save yourself.

The lectures are done so fast and there's so much information being thrown at you. The last exam there were at LEAST 200 slides. Her exams are worded so tricky.  I have been reviewing and studying and haven't passed a test yet. Please save yourself and your GPA, don't take her!! Will not curve even when the average test scores are low 60's...

Her lectures are her speeding through poorly organized slides. The stuff on the 3 exams are what she says during lectures, which she speeds through. Fortunately, she has open office hours and SI, but it's not helpful as you're likely to leave confused. Exams are heavy on memorizing stuff, like fr. Her lecture's are also not on par with the lab. GL.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take her, she is the reason im depressed. im an academic validation person so all i do is study, so if you think you will be fine because you study all the time, YOU ARENT AN EXCEPTION. Mock exams are nothing like the actual exams she gives. exams weighted heavy, no curves.gaslit myself to believe id be ok cus i took ap bio senior year LOL.

Wright speeds through lectures and doesn't spend enough time talking about the important content that's going to be on the exam. She's also a slide reader and makes all the exams are hard and have failing averages. If you registered for her, you'd be better off getting another prof or not taking bio that semester.

Worst professor I've ever taken!! Lectures were basically useless. She is unable to answer questions is a clear way and her tests are written in a confusing manner. She does not curve and says that a failing class average is normal in this class. I have never been in an intro class where the majority of people failing was deemed acceptable.

She is horrible. She does not care for her students at all. She does not curve the exams at all which I believe is a bio department thing but at least she could try learning how to teach so the averages arent so low. If you have an alpha mentality thinking you can tough it out with her.. yeah nope. dont do it to yourself

Class is lecture and power point heavy. Exam average are always around the 60s with no curves. 30 extra credit points for the whole semester, there is no other way to earn extra credit. She knows how low class averages are going to be, but she does nothing abt it. She reads off slides, and expect to know bio. She teaches on the spectrum of biochem.

She is nice which is why I give her a 2, but she talks way too fast and crams so much information into a slide. Tests are in person. Her test averages are always in the 40-60s.  Textbook is free. She gives 30 extra credit points throughout the semester, but you have present in class to complete them. I would not recommend and many people struggle.

There is a lot of content in this course and she goes very fast.  All the information on the tests comes directly from the lecture slides.  Her tests are tricky because questions are worded unfairly, and it takes some reading between the lines to figure out what the question is asking for.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her lectures are composed of her reading information off of slideshows that she posts. The information gone over in lecture isn't in depth enough to prepare you remotely for the exams. She offers a practice exam and outlines, but to be perfectly honest I found them extremely unhelpful and incomparable to her exams. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND!!!

I wish I could be nice about her but I just cant. Her powerpoints, problem sets and practice exams do not prepare a student for the exams. She expects us to apply the information from vague powerpoints. Her powerpoints are super heavy on material but they do not get into detail on stuff that she tests us. you could never be prepared in this class

DO NOT TAKE HER FOR BIO111!!! Very kind professor, however her practice exams are nothing like the actual exams, she even admitted it to the class that she just pulls them from random websites and doesn't know whats on them. I studied really hard for this class and our average was a 60 yet she wouldn't curve because "its normal"

Worst class ever. She does not know how to teach. Her class is an overall waste of time. I studied for an exam for three weeks and still managed to get a 67. Her practice exams don't reflect the difficulty for the exams.

Nice as a person, but as a professor, not great at all. She speeds through the slides and over complicates small details and goes way too far into unnecessary topics that isn't needed. The slides are very information heavy to the point where it's overwhelming. The exams are difficult and aren't curved either, so the averages are often low.

Wright is nice but moves way too quickly, and wastes so much time answering questions. Her tests are ridiculous compared to what she claims are practice exams and outlines for the test. I scored higher in organic chemistry than this intro. bio class. Everyone I knew was always confused and struggling. She doesn't curve or remove highly missed q's

This was her first year teaching biology, and she normally taught microbiology so that said a lot about her teaching style - aka she couldn't dumb it down for us. She would go through a 75 page powerpoint in a 1 hour lecture, and when asked a question that was too hard, she would say "don't worry about it". Please just save yourself
Her lectures are just markings off a checklist. She does not teach, she reads. She doesnt actually care or help you remember things for better understanding

Bro, like wtf, this professor just rushes every lecture and she basically just does not give a shit bout her students. Honestly don't take her, you don't want to be there, she doesn't want to be there. We always ended up behind on exams.

Dr. Wright is a good professor who seems very caring and nice, but during lecture she reads off the slides and goes through them really fast. All the information you need to know for the tests are on the slides, so you just have to memorize them and you will be fine. The only homework that she assigns is one problem set each week.
